messages.text: McKinney earns England Test call up for South Africa series

metadata.summary: England have added Ben McKinney to their Test squad touring South Africa next month, with the uncapped Durham opener serving as a replacement for the injured Jacob Bethell.
metadata.content: Ben McKinney earns England Test call up for South Africa series as Jacob Bethell's replacement | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Ben McKinney earns England Test call up for South Africa series as Jacob Bethell's replacement Uncapped Durham opener Ben McKinney replaces Jacob Bethell in England Test squad for South Africa after he was ruled out with a knee injury; England's white-ball side sweating on the fitness of Will Jacks after suffering a finger injury in their series-opening T20I defeat to Australia Saturday 21 November 2026 13:58, UK Image: Durham opener Ben McKinney has been called up to the England touring squad of South Africa England have added Ben McKinney to their Test squad touring South Africa next month, with the uncapped Durham opener serving as a replacement for the injured Jacob Bethell. McKinney, a 6ft 7in left-handed batter, has become a regular in the England Lions set-up and underlined his growing reputation on this month's tour of St Kitts, hitting 145 against West Indies A. He will provide competition and cover for England's top order that includes county colleague Emilio Gay. Larin turned in his eighth goal of the season but his first since 12 September - after a four-game drought and a hamstring problem.
